title: Focus on This, Not That! Steering LLMs with Adaptive Feature Specification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) dataset (both multiple-choice and a custom natural language generation variant, BBQ-NLG), measuring whether the model relies on gender stereotypes (e.g., assuming a man asked a technical question) rather than the provided context.
Evaluated using the BBQ dataset to measure the model's reliance on racial and ethnic stereotypes when answering questions with ambiguous contexts.

Assessed across 9 different social bias features in the BBQ dataset by measuring 'focus accuracy', which tests the model's ability to ignore spurious demographic attributes and stereotypical associations when explicitly instructed to focus solely on the question context.
